name: AFortAIPawn::KillWithDamageTags
signature: void KillWithDamageTags(const FGameplayTagContainer& Tags, int32 Unused, AActor* Instigator)
notes: Authority-only death path. Skips when Tags contain any of the protected FFortGlobals tags (+0x430/+0x440/+0x448), otherwise builds the death event, sends it through the ability component, and runs the stat hook when present.
